あらすじ

Hero calls a girl who he loves for a long time to the school roof to confess his feelings, but gets dumped. He gets to the heavens as a result of an accident but is kicked from there for harassing the angels. Appearing right near his passion getting into a love hotel with her boyfriend our ghost manages to possess him and that opens the doors to various fully animated sexual encounters.

item.title: Kotohigaoka Monogatari
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Miamisoft
  • 発売日: 1995-06-30
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 琴緋ヶ丘物語
  • 英語名: Kotohigaoka Monogatari

别名

  • Kotohigaoka Story

あらすじ

Oshima and Aoi are students of Kotohigaoka high school. They are secretly in love with the heroine Saeki Yuna, but can’t confess to her due to constant attention and clinging of their cousin Ayaka and younger student Maiko. Events start to unwind after Aoi is recruited as a substitute basketball team member to replace an injured player.
